sloka: न हि एषा बुद्धिः आस्थेया हनूमन् अंगदम् प्रति ।पिता हि बंधुः पुत्रस्य न माता हरि सत्तम ॥४-२१-१५॥
transliteration: na hi eṣā buddhiḥ āstheyā hanūman aṁgadam prati ।pitā hi baṁdhuḥ putrasya na mātā hari sattama ॥4-21-15॥

translations.english: 'O Hanuman the best of monkeys, you need not think about (the future of) Angada. A father plans for a son and not (even) the mother.
